statement: Pinned AntiMicroX input daemon discovers and opens joysticks via SDL2 SDL_NumJoysticks/SDL_JoystickOpen and optionally GameController mapping rather than running its own Wii Remote report, MotionPlus activation or calibration. It can be an acceptance target for ordinary virtual buttons/axes when SDL makes either UHID or uinput realization visible, but should not be presented as an independent native Wii gyro protocol consumer.
